text: This PRD stays in Draft and records no approval.
why: The run overlay D-RCV-60 requires no human approval; the playbook gate is met by carrying the missing approval as an assumption
read: Approval table empty, status Draft, section 13 states the position
impact: Wave 1 build cannot start on an approved baseline until a decision is recorded

text: FSD P9 has no requirement IDs, so FR and AC rows trace to FEAT-RPT-nn and AC-P9-nnn-nn.
why: The FSD 'Requirements served' table is empty; inventing a REQ- key would be a fabricated identifier
read: The FSD-source column of every FR and AC row names a feature ID and an acceptance criterion ID
impact: Traceability runs to the FSD's own IDs; a program-level key can be added later

text: The service is created in wave 1 and serves EP02, EP06 and EP08 from the same read model.
why: Program v5 section 10.2 gives RWB-SVC-P9 wave 1 and the business epics EP01 to EP08; a service is created when its first epic starts
read: Release slices in section 10 run wave 1, wave 2 and wave 4 in one service
impact: Later-epic capabilities are added as reports over the existing read model, not as a new service

text: Every Power BI and data lake destination of the FSD is read as the reporting read model served on the gateway-bff route, and every lake delivery as a file delivered by rwb-integration.
why: ADR-018 and DP-17 remove INT-19 and INT-20; Architecture v5 gives rwb-reporting the dashboard and report resources and deliverFile on rwb-integration
read: No measure or extract leaves the read model except through a resource or a delivered file
impact: One requirement (RWB-E2-009) keeps its outcome and loses its stated vehicle; a lake-based acceptance criterion becomes a file-based one

text: The measure run is a Temporal Schedule at 01:30 and the report run operation is the same run's other entry point, so the bank scheduler can trigger it.
why: Arch v5 slide 15 gives a Schedule at 01:30 and slide 44 gives an Airflow trigger for JOB-15; both are in the higher-precedence catalogue slides
read: One run per report and business date, refused if it is already running
confirm: Solution architect with the bank platform team
impact: A duplicate run is refused, so the two entries cannot double-publish

text: The report identifier is read as the measure report for the measure read, so GET /reports/{id} and GET /reports/measures name the same resource family.
why: Arch v5 names /reports/{id} and the Ownership Map names /reports/measures; neither states what {id} takes
read: Both paths appear in this PRD and the contract carries one
confirm: Solution architect with the API owner
impact: The published contract must choose one path before the contract baseline story closes

text: The published measure set is the six approved definitions plus CASES_BY_STAGE, DECISIONS_LOGGED and the two agent measures; the count of seven is not reconcilable from the source.
why: AC-P9-001-01 defines six, AC-P9-003-01 counts seven and the alternate flows name four further measures
read: Every measure named in any P9 acceptance criterion is published, and the count is carried as OQ-P9-03
confirm: Tribe lead with the Reporting and BI analyst
impact: The refresh check cannot be written as 'seven' until the set is fixed

text: Operational and decision measures are counted from the decision record received on rwb.decision-record.v1, and the live log store is never read.
why: RWB-E1-014 is retired, ADR-018 removes the lake and rwb-decision ingests continuously from Kafka
read: Every decision measure names the decision record as its source
impact: The copy's watermark and partition checks apply to the extract, not to the log

text: The reconciliation result and the break rows are read from rwb-source-data's contract, and the break view and its closure live in this service.
why: reconciliation_result and JOB-04 belong to P1 and RWB-E1-011 traces to RWB-SVC-P1; FEAT-RPT-09 needs a working surface
read: This service recomputes no reconciliation and holds no copy of the result
confirm: Data steward and data product owner with P1
impact: A closure is a decision record here and a result row there, so the two must agree

text: Queue depth, ageing and owner spread are computed in rwb-case and published here for the business date, reconciled to the case list count.
why: queue_measure and JOB-06 belong to P3 and FEAT-CWC-18 publishes the measures to reporting
read: This service computes no queue measure of its own
impact: The publication gate compares two numbers from two services, so both must be taken at the same time

text: Classification, staging and re-ageing are built in this service under BR-083 pending confirmation of the owner.
why: The FSD and the split plan give P9 the primary, while Architecture v5 names no service for the duty
read: The rules are versioned reference data and the segment is recomputed from the valid-from date
impact: If the duty moves, the capability moves with it and wave 4 loses a slice

text: Attributes named in the P9 acceptance criteria are carried as key fields; the remaining fields of five reporting entities are placeholders.
why: Only measure_definition has a field catalog in the FSD, with eight fields
read: Every other entity carries the placeholder of Template and Rules R9
impact: The physical schema cannot be built until the field lists are agreed

text: Every reporting entity declares a retention class now and takes its period from DL26 when it is set.
why: NFR-030 and NFR-031 carry open periods and DL26 is unanswered
read: A snapshot, an extract and a run record carry a class and an open period
impact: A disposal cannot be evidenced until the periods are set

text: Benefit realisation reports each measured value against the frozen baseline and states where the benefit model sets no measure or no target.
why: BR-061 requires monthly tracking and KPI-014 records that targets are not set; Q-020 is unanswered
read: No variance and no target are computed where none is set
impact: The Epic 6 benefit report shows movement only, until the model is supplied

text: The regulatory extract is built from the reporting read model and the decision record and delivered as a file by rwb-integration.
why: BR-082 requires the return to agree with the decision record and Q-018 has no answer; Architecture v5 gives P9 deliverFile through rwb-integration
read: The return names its data products and the decision record as its sources
impact: A change of source would change the return's reconciliation, not its delivery

text: The dashboard data set and the report reads are served by this service on the dashboard and report resources, read through gateway-bff, and the screen itself belongs to the edge.
why: Arch v5 gives P9 /dashboards/{id} and the edge the composite route; the FSD names SCR-37 without an owner
read: No screen is designed here; the resource is the product
impact: A composition at the edge would move browser latency into the gateway budget

text: Agent acceptance and override are counted from the decision record, which carries the agent and prompt version, the recommendation, the approval and the outcome.
why: EV-28 does not list this service as a consumer and the consumer matrix gives no P10 dependency, while REQ-DRI-001 puts the agent version and the outcome in every decision record
read: No new interface to rwb-agent is added for the agent measures
confirm: Solution architect with the AI product owner
impact: A per-run agent measure (latency, cost) needs a source the record does not carry

text: Message IDs keep the prefix of the module they were written for and are treated as shared messages.
why: FSD P9 reuses MSG-P1-xxx, MSG-P2-006, MSG-P3-xxx and MSG-P7-003; renumbering them would break the trace to the source
read: No message ID is changed or reissued in this PRD
impact: The message catalogue must list them once, under their owning module

text: Agent acceptance and override are published per agent and version with no threshold, and an agent with no recommendations shows 'No runs'.
why: NFR-066 asks for the measures without a target, Q-026 is unanswered and the FSD states only the 'No runs' behaviour
read: No target and no zero value is written
impact: A reader cannot tell whether a rate is good until a target is agreed

text: No person is named in this document and every owner is a role or a service code.
why: Root rule 4 and U3; the source documents name decision owners as people in places
read: Roles only, taken from the Ownership Map and the BRD owner columns
impact: An escalation path names a role, not a mailbox

text: Role, masking policy, the access log and the delegation of authority stay with rwb-access and ACE common sign-in.
why: Architecture v5 and the Ownership Map give P4 the role matrix, the masking policy and the access log
read: This service holds no role table and no masking rule
impact: A masking change is a change in P4, released once for every service

text: This document is version 1 of the PRD P9 family; there is no earlier version to supersede.
why: The PRD folder held two files when this work package ran, for P1 and P2, and no P9 file
read: The change log carries one row and the ID set is new
impact: A later revision takes v2 and keeps this ID set
